features.name: Running Leap
features.description: At 3rd level, while raging, you can leap further. Standing long jump: up to your STR score in feet. With a 10-ft running start: up to twice your STR score in feet.

features.name: Roar of Defiance
features.description:
Beginning at 3rd level, when you enter your rage, you can unleash a thunderous roar as part of the bonus action. Until the start of your next turn, each creature of your choice within 30 ft that can hear you has disadvantage on attack rolls that don't target you.

Until the rage ends, if a creature within 5 ft that heard your roar deals damage to you, you can use your reaction to bellow: CON save (DC 8 + prof + CHA mod) or take 1d6 thunder damage (2d6 at 10th level). Each creature can only be affected once per rage.

payload.name: Roar of Defiance
payload.description: When a creature within 5 ft that heard your Roar of Defiance damages you while raging: CON save or 1d6 thunder (2d6 at L10). Once per creature per rage.

features.name: Lion's Glory
features.description: Starting at 6th level, when you enter your rage, choose a number of allies that can see you equal to your CHA modifier (minimum 1). Until the rage ends, when a chosen ally makes a melee weapon attack, they gain a bonus to damage equal to your Rage Damage bonus. 1/long rest.

features.name: Resonant Bellow
features.description: At 10th level, as a bonus action, unleash a mighty roar: end the frightened condition on yourself and each creature of your choice within 60 ft that can hear you. Each creature that stops being frightened gains 1d12 + CHA modifier (min +1) temporary HP for 1 hour. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Resonant Bellow
payload.description: End frightened on self and chosen allies within 60 ft (who can hear you). Each gains 1d12 + CHA mod temp HP for 1 hour.

features.name: Victorious Roar
features.description: At 14th level, when you hit with at least two attacks on the same turn, you can use a bonus action to unleash a victorious roar. One creature within 30 ft must make a WIS save (DC 8 + prof + CHA mod): fail = psychic damage equal to barbarian level + frightened until end of its next turn; success = half damage, not frightened.

payload.name: Victorious Roar
payload.description: After hitting with 2+ attacks this turn: one creature within 30 ft makes WIS save or takes psychic damage = barbarian level and is frightened until end of its next turn.
